reason: I already pay for a booking engine and a channel manager, and my guests already find me on Instagram. A new page and a boat-transfer story sound nice, but I cannot see what the $800 buys that the booking engine I pay for every month does not already do. I answer the WhatsApps myself at night, so I would rather spend the money on a room or a repair.
objection: The $650 is an illustration built on a made-up month, and it assumes every direct guest would otherwise have gone through Booking.com. Some of mine would not come direct at all, and the deposit system and the reminders have costs and staff time that the slide does not count.
would_change_my_mind: A real before-and-after from a guesthouse like mine, with its own commission and booking numbers, showing the direct share rising and what it cost to set up, plus proof that the booking engine I already pay for can take the new page without a second subscription.
